test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

My daughter was / invited to lunch / hosted by the Governor / at his residence.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**a**" before the term "**lunch**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article ("a" or "an").
 
• The correct phrase should be "**to a lunch**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My daughter was invited to a lunch hosted by the Governor at his residence."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "at his residence"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "hosted by the Governor"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "My daughter was"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
